traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.summary: Choose a dragon ancestor; the choice determines the damage type used by Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.summary: Replace one attack with a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line. Damage scales with character level and uses are tied to Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.summary: Gain resistance to the damage type associated with the chosen dragon ancestor.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision to 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.summary: At level 5, gain temporary spectral wings and a Fly Speed equal to Speed once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision to 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.summary: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.summary: Hit Point maximum increases by 1 at level 1 and by 1 whenever another level is gained.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.summary: While touching stone, temporarily gain Tremorsense to 60 feet. Uses are tied to Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision to 60 feet; Drow lineage extends it to 120 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.summary: Choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf to gain lineage magic and additional benefits.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.summary: Gain proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.summary: Magic cannot put you to sleep, and a Long Rest can be completed in four hours of conscious meditation.

options.name: High Elf
level1: Prestidigitation cantrip, replaceable with another Wizard cantrip after a Long Rest

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision to 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.summary: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.summary: Choose Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome for lineage magic and special abilities.

options.name: Forest Gnome
benefits: Speak with Animals is always prepared and can be cast without a spell slot a number of times equal to Proficiency Bonus

options.name: Rock Gnome
benefits: Create temporary Tiny clockwork devices using Prestidigitation

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.summary: Choose one supernatural boon associated with Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, or Storm Giants.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.summary: At level 5, temporarily become Large, gain Advantage on Strength checks, and increase Speed by 10 feet once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.summary: Advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

options.name: Cloud’s Jaunt
options.summary: Teleport up to 30 feet as a Bonus Action.

options.name: Fire’s Burn
options.summary: Deal an additional 1d10 Fire damage after hitting with an attack.

options.name: Frost’s Chill
options.summary: Deal an additional 1d6 Cold damage and reduce the target’s Speed by 10 feet.

options.name: Hill’s Tumble
options.summary: After damaging a Large or smaller creature with an attack, knock it Prone.

options.name: Stone’s Endurance
options.summary: Use a Reaction to reduce incoming damage by 1d12 plus Constitution modifier.

options.name: Storm’s Thunder
options.summary: Use a Reaction after taking damage to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to a nearby creature.

traits.name: Brave
traits.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.summary: Move through the space of creatures larger than you, though you cannot stop there.

traits.name: Luck
traits.summary: Reroll a 1 rolled on the d20 of a D20 Test and use the new result.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.summary: Take the Hide action while obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.

size.description: Small or Medium, chosen when the species is selected

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.summary: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.summary: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.summary: Gain one Origin feat of your choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.summary: Take Dash as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to Proficiency Bonus. Uses are tied to Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision to 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.summary: When reduced to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, drop to 1 Hit Point instead once per Long Rest.

size.description: Small or Medium, chosen when the species is selected

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision to 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.summary: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal to gain a resistance, cantrip, and additional spells at levels 3 and 5.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.summary: Know the Thaumaturgy cantrip using the spellcasting ability chosen for Fiendish Legacy.
